accuracy.suggested_fix: This is a code-level incompatibility between lm_eval harness and the KimiLinearForCausalLM quantized wrapper class. The quantized model's __init__ needs to accept (and ignore or handle) the torch_compile kwarg, or lm_eval needs to be configured to not pass it. Neither can be fixed via retry alone — requires patching either the quantized model's wrapper class or the lm_eval harness argument construction.
